name: PART_OF
description: The subject element of the architecture model is part of the object: a component of the deployable unit it runs in (#523).

role.description: For a component, what it is built around: an entry point (controller, listener, job, gateway filter, STOMP handler, WebSocket registration), an aspect that advises one, a bean several entry points share or that reaches outside the unit, or the routes a gateway's config defines.

technology.description: For a component, what it is, as the component diagram labels it, such as Spring MVC REST controller or Spring Data JPA repository.

facts.description: The facts that give the component's anchor its role, the first giving its evidence.

name: ANCHORED_ON
description: The subject component is built around the object: the class of its entry point, aspect or shared bean, or the module whose config defines a gateway's routes (#523).

name: HAS_MEMBER
description: The subject component holds the object class: its anchor, or a bean only its anchor reaches (#523). A kind of CONTAINS, a type of its own so derivation does not write what the extractors write.
